sentences.text: BUSSINESS
R/O VILLAGE DIYAPEEPAR POLICE

STATION GOHPARU DISTRICT SHAHDOL (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI JITENDRA TIWARI - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MAHILA THANA DISTRICT KATNI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI NARENDRA CHOURASIYA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:

ORDER This is the First application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.06/2023 registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Katni for t h e offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) of the IPC.
2.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complainant is wife of brother-in-law of applicant.

Complainant and her husband are at logger heads because of domestic dispute and at her instance, a case was registered against her in-laws vide Crime No.510/2021 at Police Station Vijayraghavgarh, District Katni for offence under Section 294, 323 and 506/34 of IPC on 07.12.2021.
As per allegations, in the present case, for the first time, present applicant committed rape on 15.07.2021 much before the above referred case.

Therefore, complainant if she wanted then could have filed the complaint then and there only but incident is dated 15.07.2021 an FIR was Shekh Subham Mansuri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153381325/
1 registered on 02.02.2023, after more than one and a half years of commission of offence of rape for the first time.

sentences.text: Omnibus sort of allegations are levelled by prosecutrix against the applicant.
Allegations are mainly driven by dispute existing between complainant and her husband.

Earlier,
present applicant intervened in the matter for mediation and, therefore, being aggrieved by the same, these allegations have been levelled.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Confinement may bring social disrepute and personal inconvenience, specially when allegations are delayed by time and are just to harass the applicant.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in the investigation/trial and to make himself available as and when required.
He would not be source of harassment and embarrassment in any manner to the prosecutrix.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.
Considering the submissions advance by the learned counsel for the parties
, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest,
the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority/trial Court.

entities.text: Shekh Subham Mansuri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Application stands allowed and disposed of.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE AT Shekh Subham Mansuri vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153381325/
